caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot centered on a plain, off-white or beige background. The teapot is rendered in shades of gray with yellow highlights accentuating its lid, spout, handle, and decorative edges. The lid of the teapot features a twisted finial with yellow detailing, and the teapot’s body is round with a short neck and flared rim. The spout is elongated, curving outward with yellow accents, and the handle has a scroll-like design, also highlighted in yellow. On the side of the teapot’s body, there is a small landscape scene sketched in blue, showing water, land, and possibly buildings or structures in the distance. Near the lower right, there is a small, blue signature. The drawing is neatly contained within a faintly outlined rectangular border.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
